name: Ballinastoe Trail
notes:
First version of Ballinastoe Trail. 🚵

- Live map of the Ballinastoe trails with the trail you're on.
- Spoken directions at junctions; music ducks while it speaks.
- Automatic timing of every one-way section, and racing your last or best run.
- Weather from Met Éireann: the screen matches it, plus rain and sunset warnings.
- History, best times and GPX export. Practice rides to try it at home.
